title: screener channel — schema-first (AFB backend<->AFB frontend only; not part of afb.execution.v1 wire)
description: Negotiated via auth.support/auth_ok.support (capability id afbws.screener.channel.v1). Read-only access to the screener's published JSON exports (contract v1, see AFB/docs/SCREENER_RESULTS.md); the backend never opens the screener database. Same convention as afbws.market/afbws.config: ONE schema id per message (`afbws.screener.<op>.v1`, no .request/.response suffixes); the same schema is the request and its response. `request_id` is required everywhere: there are no server pushes in this version (the client refreshes on demand). A failed request is answered with `afbws.screener.error.v1`. Operations: `list` (available exports, newest first, content not read), `get` (one export by id) and `participants` (market participants snapshot: four lists now/d1/d2/w1 of derivatives with fiz/yur positions, open interest and volume, computed by the backend from market_cache). Export ids: `night:YYYY-MM-DD` (night result of a trading day), `intraday:YYYY-MM-DDTHHMM` (intraday snapshot), or the aliases `latest` (newest night export) and `intraday_latest` (newest intraday snapshot). Access requires the `screener` capability of the user's role; otherwise `forbidden`. The exported document is intentionally an open object: only `contract_version` is relied upon; the screener's fields (signals, reliability, models, errors) evolve and are described in AFB/docs/SCREENER_RESULTS.md. A document with an unsupported `contract_version` is answered with `unsupported_action`. See AFB/docs/ws/screener.md.

exportId.description: Concrete export id: `night:YYYY-MM-DD` or `intraday:YYYY-MM-DDTHHMM` (trading day and MSK moment, no separators in the time).

exportRef.description: Export id or alias: `latest` (newest night export) / `intraday_latest` (newest intraday snapshot).

asof.description: Moment of the export's signals (MSK, no zone), derived from the file name; `night`: 19:00 of trading_day.

generated_at.description: File modification time (ISO 8601 with zone); the content is not read for the list.

list.title: afbws.screener.list.v1 — available exports (request / response).
list.description: Request carries only optional filters. Response carries `items` (newest first) and the ids of the newest exports: `latest` (newest night export) and `intraday_latest` (newest intraday snapshot), each null when there is none. Both are computed from file names, not from the screener's latest*.json copies.

kind.description: Request: only exports of this kind.

limit.description: Request: at most this many newest items.

get.title: afbws.screener.get.v1 — one export (request / response).
get.description: Request carries `id` (export id or alias). Response echoes the concrete `id` (aliases resolved) and `kind`, and carries `document`: the export content as is (contract v1), an open object. Unknown export: error `not_found`; malformed id: `invalid_schema`; unreadable file: `internal_error`; unsupported `contract_version`: `unsupported_action`.

id.description: Request: export id or alias. Response: concrete export id.

document.description: Response only. Screener export content as is; see AFB/docs/SCREENER_RESULTS.md.

favoriteColor.description: Same list and order as afbws.instrument.channel.v2 favoriteColor (kept in lockstep; no cross-reference on purpose).

participantsItem.description: One derivative row. Open object: extra fields allowed. A missing value is null.

active_instrument_key.description: Nearest unexpired contract instrument_key (to open a chart).

collection_id.description: Root catalog collection of the asset.

key.description: now = current moment; d1 = previous trading day close; d2 = trading day before d1; w1 = last trading day <= today - 7 calendar days.

asof.description: Moment of the values (MSK, no zone); for `now` the intraday slot.

participants.title: afbws.screener.participants.v1 — market participants snapshot (request / response).
participants.description: Request is an empty command (no parameters in this version). Response carries `received_at`, `tz` and `lists` (four lists: now, d1, d2, w1). Same capability as list/get: `screener` of the user's role, otherwise `forbidden`. Non-manager sees only derivatives visible to their tier.

tz.description: Response only. Time zone of asof, e.g. Europe/Moscow.

error.title: afbws.screener.error.v1 — typed error for a whole request (server -> client).
